title: Comments
description:
Comments are just special charecters that say "_Hey code runner, this isnt code_" and that's it. There are two types of comments: single line and multi line. You make a single line comment with the syntax `// Comment` Meanwhile multi line comments use the syntax `/*` to start them and are comments till `*/`.
## Assignment:
Somebody at the Verdigris OS team accidently made a bug and commented out the working code! You need to fix it.
expectedOutput: This is a thing i coded. Please don't comment me out.
